settings.offlineStillWorks: Printer & notification settings still work offline.
settings.autoAcceptHelp: Orders confirm automatically. If the requested slot is full, the order bumps to the next available slot. Only confirms when there is capacity. Orders with customer notes (e.g. an allergy) will still need to be confirmed.
settings.layoutHelp: How items appear on the Add order screen.
settings.layoutTabsHelp: Show one category at a time. Tap a category to switch. Best for longer menus, where every item stays in the same place.
settings.layoutScrollHelp: Show every item in one scrolling list, with a heading for each category. There are no category buttons - you scroll to move around. Best for shorter menus, where you can see most of it at once.
settings.paidStepHelp: Adds a Confirm button when you add an order yourself, so you can place it now and take payment later.
settings.completionHelp: What happens when an unpaid order is ready to hand over.
settings.pressesOneHelp: Best when you take the money as you hand the food over. You get a single button, “Mark paid & collected”, which records the payment and clears the order together.
settings.pressesTwoHelp: Best when payment and handover happen at different moments — someone pays at the hatch, then collects when it’s ready. You get two buttons: “Mark paid” first, then “Collected” when they take the food.
settings.takesCashHelp: Splits the payment button into "Cash" and "Card".
settings.orderReadyHelp: Show a “Mark ready” button on the orders screen. Kitchen screens are set separately. Customers are emailed whenever an order is marked ready.
settings.buzzerPromptTitle: Remind me to add a buzzer
settings.buzzerPromptHelp: Opens the buzzer grid as soon as you place an order, so the number goes on the board while the customer is still in front of you. With it off you can still add a buzzer any time by tapping the order, but nothing will prompt you. Useful where you hand buzzers out, easy to switch off where you don’t.
settings.cardsHelp: Turn this off during a card problem and customers will place orders as normal and pay at the hatch instead. Orders keep coming; only the card step stops.
settings.cardsScope: This applies to your whole truck, on every event, and stays off until you turn it back on.
settings.soundsHelp: The on/off switch is on each screen; every device controls its own sound.
settings.dueSoundTitle: Sound when an order is due to be cooked
settings.dueSoundHelp: Sounds when a ticket turns amber.
settings.intervalsHelp: How far apart collection times are. This doesn't change kitchen capacity or prep times.
settings.intervalsUnavailable: Collection times are unavailable right now.
settings.canPick: {who, select, customers {Customers can pick {example}} other {You and your customers can pick {example}}}
settings.differentTimes: Use different times for orders I add
settings.colCountsTitle: Which categories count toward the total capacity. Cooked categories always count; tick instant ones (sides, dips, drinks) to include them.
settings.countsLocked: Cooked — always counts (its prep & batch set the pace)
settings.countsNoCap: Set a capacity to choose which categories count
settings.countsTick: Tick to include this instant category (sides, dips, drinks) in the shared per-window limit
settings.assignTruck: Assign a truck to this event before setting kitchen capacity.
settings.setCapacityFirst: Set a capacity to choose which categories count.

stock.ownPriceTitle: This event’s own price — press × to go back to the type or menu price
stock.priceTitle: What customers pay at this event
stock.followsCategoryTitle: Following category total — type a number to cap
stock.optionsHelp: Shared across all dishes that use them. This count does not reset per event — it's a running total for the whole service.
stock.howCategory: Category total is a shared pool across every item in that category (e.g. 30 starters tonight).
stock.howItem: Item limit caps just that one item within the pool (e.g. only 8 Pepperoni) — leave it blank to draw from the pool with no cap of its own.
stock.howFirst: Whichever runs out first applies — the category pool or the item's own limit.
stock.howAvailable: Available: green = on sale, grey = sold out (hidden from customers).
stock.howEdit: Edit: configure prep time, batch size, and notes per category.
